argument-hint: '[screen or feature]'
---

# Design Handoff

For each component/page provide:
- Purpose and user task.
- Layout hierarchy and responsive behavior.
- Token references.
- Component anatomy and variants.
- Interaction and keyboard behavior.
- All relevant states.
- Accessibility requirements.
- Data requirements and empty/error cases.
- Acceptance criteria and visual evidence needed.

Reference source docs; do not duplicate conflicting specs. Flag unresolved details rather than making assumptions. Handoff is complete only when the implementer can build without inventing key design decisions.
